overview: Kenya is a country in East Africa, on the Indian Ocean. Its capital and largest city is Nairobi. Kenya became independent from the United Kingdom in 1963. Swahili and English are its official languages. Kenya is famous for wildlife safaris and for its long-distance runners, who have won many Olympic medals.

geography.text: Kenya rises from a coastal strip on the Indian Ocean to high plateaus in the centre and west, split by the Great Rift Valley. Mount Kenya, the second-highest mountain in Africa, stands close to the equator. The north is dry and semi-desert, while the south-west borders Lake Victoria and includes the Maasai Mara, famous for its great wildebeest migration.
